database_specific.remediation_guidance: Enforces immutability on org_id and tenant_id fields.

details:
### Vulnerability Condition: Tenant Hijacking via Org ID Overwrite

**Category**: Improper Multi-Tenancy
**CWE**: CWE-284
**Target Tool**: `update_user_roles`

#### Vulnerable Behavior
Permits callers to update org_id to a different tenant namespace.

#### Secure Mitigation
Enforces immutability on org_id and tenant_id fields.

#### Description
Profile updates allow callers to overwrite their tenant_id/org_id attribute.
summary: Tenant Hijacking via Org ID Overwrite in Identity & Role-Based Access Control (mcp-auth-rbac)
